name: Garden Route
blurb: Garden Route has appeared in travel conversation only in the last few weeks, from a base of almost nothing. Early posts are enthusiastic but the sample is still small.

positive: Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
negative: Some report crowding at peak times

quotes.text: Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
Not the easiest place to reach, which is probably why it is still calm.
